content_units: Weekend Watch Match
You need   2 titles across 2 evenings   within   270 minutes total  , with:
-   1 animated film
-   1 mystery or comedy
- No bleak ending
- Strong pacing preferred
Best fit:   Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse + Game Night
Total time:   217 minutes (3h 37m)
Best Two-Movie Combination
Pick   Type   Runtime   Why it fits
Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse   Animated   117m   Fast, energetic, emotionally upbeat, and the strongest animated option for pacing
Game Night   Comedy/Mystery   100m   Very brisk, funny, mystery-driven, and light rather than bleak
Why this is the strongest choice
-   Meets every constraint cleanly  : one animated title and one comedy/mystery title.
-   Comfortably under the time cap  : 217 minutes leaves   53 minutes spare  .
-   Best pacing match  : both films move quickly and stay engaging without feeling heavy.
-   Ending tone works  : both are broadly satisfying and not bleak.
-   Good weekend balance  : one visually inventive crowd-pleaser, one lighter live-action laugh/mystery nightcap.
Suggested evening split
Evening 1: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
- Great for the higher-energy slot.
- Stylish, emotionally warm, and consistently propulsive.
Evening 2: Game Night
- Easy, funny second-night watch.
- Keeps the weekend from ending on a serious or sentimental note.
Why the other likely options rank lower
Option 1:   Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse + Knives Out     Great alternative if you want a stronger pure mystery     247 minutes
- Also an excellent fit.
- Slightly longer, and   Knives Out   is a bit more talky/deductive than   Game Night  , so it’s not quite as strong for the “fast pacing” preference.
Option 2:   Coco + Game Night     Warm and crowd-friendly pairing     205 minutes
- Very safe and upbeat.
- Loses to the top pick because   Spider-Verse   is usually the better match for someone who wants sharper momentum.
Option 3:   Paddington 2 + Knives Out     Charming plus clever mystery     234 minutes
- Strong tonal fit and very accessible.
- Slightly gentler pace overall than the winning pair.
Option 4:   The Grand Budapest Hotel + Coco     Stylish and heartfelt     205 minutes
- Fits the rules if you treat the second pick as comedy.
- Less ideal because it’s a more particular tone and not as universally “fast” as the winner.
Final Recommendation
Choose   Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse   for the animated slot and   Game Night   for the mystery/comedy slot.

This pairing gives you the   best blend of speed, fun, upbeat payoff, and variety   while staying well inside your time limit. If you want a slightly more puzzle-forward version, swap   Game Night   for   Knives Out  .
